summary.text:
Tech weakness drove divergence as AI concerns pressured equities. Nvidia fell 5.86% to 155.38 and the Nasdaq dropped 1.99%, dragging the Nikkei down 3.3%. In contrast, the Dow gained 0.85% to 50,018.70. Geopolitical risks also surfaced after a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia's PIF tower injured 11 people.

The US Dollar Index held steady at 103.895, though the euro gained 0.44% to 1.0957 and sterling rose 0.51% to 1.3101. USD/JPY edged up 0.09% to 159.153. Commodities were flat, with gold at 3,549.8 and Brent crude at 87.57. Meanwhile, Bitcoin retreated 3.59% to 59,013.91.

Investors are watching tech and geopolitical developments following Huawei's US criminal conviction for trade secret theft and fraud. Attention also centers on potential AI fallout across Asian data centres, elevated Middle East tensions, and corporate earnings following releases from GoodRx and BBVA Argentina.
